openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: The GL.iNet GL-MT3000 or Beryl AX is a travel router that was released in 2023. It has two Ethernet ports (2.5 Gbps WAN and 1 Gbps LAN), two 802.11ax/Wi-Fi 6 radios (2.4GHz/5GHz), one USB 3.0 Type-A port, one USB-C port for power, and a toggle switch customizable through the OEM web UI. GL.iNet ships the device with a customized version of OpenWrt that uses their own web UI by default.
openwrt_wiki.OEM web UI Installation: Browse to http://192.168.8.1/#/upgrade, upload image file for sysupgrade, do not keep the configuration. Alternativ LuCI unter http://192.168.8.1/cgi-bin/luci, System/Backup-Flash Firmware.
openwrt_wiki.Uboot web interface: Connect your computer to the lan port of the router. See the GL.iNet website for details for getting into Uboot. Alternatively, if you have a serial cable, you can type "gl" during the 2 sec pause in the boot to enter the bootloader, then type "httpd" to start the web interface. Set your computer's IP address to 192.168.1.2. Upload the factory firmware for Uboot.
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: There are 4 screws on the bottom under the two rubber strips. You can pry just the ends of the strips up to get at the screws. After the screws are out you can split the case. Starting at the back near the corners seems easiest. There are clips at the back and sides.

cnx_review.Unboxing: 5V/3A USB-C power supply along with US, EU, and UK plug adapters; USB Type-C power input, 2.5GbE and GbE ports, USB 3.0 port on the rear panel; reset and toggle buttons visible when the external antennas are adjusted vertically; status LED at the front
cnx_review.Teardown: remove the rubber pads and loosen the four screws underneath; depression under the sticker without screw; top parts clipped; fan on a fairly large and thick heatsink; two wires to the external antennas plus an additional internal antenna (5 GHz); 4-pin UART header for console access; fan with more than two wires (PWM); 2.5GbE via MaxLinear PHY, probably GPY211; GL.iNet provides an internal photo with clear markings
cnx_review.Kommentar-Korrektur: The 2 external antennas are dual 2.4 and 5 Ghz, in addition to the internal 5 Ghz antenna.
